evidence.title: shadcn/ui components library for React and Figma – shadcncraft

name: shadcncraft
summary: Component library page of shadcncraft, filtered to the free shadcn/ui components and blocks for React and Figma.
description: Production-ready shadcn/ui components that extend the core shadcn system with deeper states, patterns and real-world use cases, plus page blocks, apps and a matching Figma UI kit. This page lists the free components; the full library is Pro.
contains: 268 installable items in the shadcn registry
extends the core shadcn/ui system with production states and interaction patterns
matching Figma UI kit and React components
this page lists the free components; the full library is Pro
site also ships blocks, apps, agent skills, themes and Storybook
